description: This file implements a Node.js script for an MCP proxy that rewrites certain JSON lines to inject MCP server information into specific method calls, and manages spawning a child process to run the target command with this modified input.

methods.name: decodePayload
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to extract and decode the MCP payload, returning the target command and MCP servers.

methods.name: shouldInject
methods.description: Determines whether a method name qualifies for MCP injection based on predefined method names.

methods.name: rewriteLine
methods.description: Attempts to parse and modify a line of JSON to inject MCP server info into certain method calls if applicable.

methods.name: isMainModule
methods.description: Checks if the current module is the main entry point for execution.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that sets up the child process and input/output loop, performing payload decoding and line rewriting.
